direction_rules: Paired forward/reverse for derivation-bearing loops with genuinely different routes disclosed in the contract; single direction plus an independent skeptic replay written from the contract alone for formula-instantiating certificates; statement plus skeptic for state/continuum statements. Same-author passes are never independent review.
assistants: After each sub-round one research assistant/coder per lens (historical, jung, modern) runs the tests named in the lenses' loop-2 responses; their outputs live under research/round32/experts/<lens>/assistant-<subround>/ and count zero research loops.
goal_change_rule: After each sub-round's panel update the advisor may reorder, replace or retitle the next pair; the change is recorded in the next selection note and this plan's history field.

preregistration_vocabulary_extensions.reason: Jung assistant-2 audit found three schema gaps in the sub-round 3-5 drafts
preregistration_vocabulary_extensions.selected_triple_alpha_units: may be an exact expression in tau (e.g. ['tau/24','tau/24','tau/24'] for the uniform model) or the string 'n/a (finite graph)' with the model_id naming the finite graph
preregistration_vocabulary_extensions.direction: allowed values: paired, single+skeptic, statement-only, statement+skeptic (a statement loop with a skeptic review and a small exact checker)
preregistration_vocabulary_extensions.reference_route: allowed values: haar, selected_strip, own_finite_graph, n/a (statement loops only, with the reason in error_terms_itemized)
preregistration_vocabulary_extensions.tau.value: an exact rational, a rule reference, or 'grid' with the grid enumerated in parameters (finite-graph loops)
preregistration_vocabulary_extensions.applies_to: AX1 (already frozen; recorded here and in its gate as an accepted extension, contract unamended), AX2, AY1, AY2, AZ1, AZ2

preregistration_vocabulary_extensions.reason: Jung assistant-4 audit found five further schema gaps in the sub-round 4-5 record
preregistration_vocabulary_extensions.state_provenance: may name more than one family at once, as a single string listing each family's own closed-vocabulary description, in the order the contract's own family list gives them, when a statement loop compares subsequential limits from more than one named family together
preregistration_vocabulary_extensions.gate_fields_required: must include rate_in_N_claimed in addition to (not instead of) rate_claimed whenever a rate-in-N claim is at stake; the field is not universal across every contract but names the boolean claim-flags the loop's own subject matter puts at risk (the six-name state-identification union for a state-identification loop; continuum_claim/uniform_in_a_claimed/weak_coupling_claim/loop_count_fraction_claimed for a continuum-trajectory statement; transfers_to_aq/model_is_finite_graph/fg_coefficients_fitted for a finite-graph loop)
preregistration_vocabulary_extensions.mandatory_sentence_template: a mandatory_sentence_template field is required in any contract whose required items cite 'the mandatory sentence template'; where more than one valid template form exists (a contract form and a Jung loop-2 restatement, as in AY1/AY2), the contract or gate must name which form governs admission
preregistration_vocabulary_extensions.the_AQ_state_phrase: the phrase 'uniqueness of the AQ state' is replaced in every contract frozen after 2026-09-24 by 'uniqueness of any subsequential limit', matching loop2-response.md section 4 exactly; frozen contracts (ay1.json, ay2.json and earlier) stay unamended, the phrase there remains inside an excluded-claim list and is never asserted
preregistration_vocabulary_extensions.target_of_a_certification_loop: a statement+skeptic loop whose subject is an already-admitted constant states in its preregistration.target block that the target is a feasibility or format check on an admitted quantity, not a blind discovery threshold (AY2 is recorded as the accepted exception, contract unamended)
preregistration_vocabulary_extensions.applies_to: AZ1, AZ2 and every later contract; AY1 and AY2 are recorded here as grandfathered exactly as AX1 was in the 2026-09-24 extension above, contracts unamended
